sources.note: Nothing. Appendix B.1 'Characteristics of Mur Pano' (pp. 39-41) gives only a phone chart (p b t d k g, m n ŋ, r, s, j w, l; vowels i e ɛ a ə ɔ o u plus diphthongs) and morphology/word-order notes; no mention of stress, accent or tone anywhere in the report; text-layer wordlists (App. C/D) and image wordlists (App. E, checked visually p.55) carry no stress marks.

tone.says: Silent on tone and on stress - the words tone/tonal/stress/pitch/intonation occur nowhere in the 66 pages. The report is about the three Mur village vernaculars (Mur Pano, Molet, Dawang); its Appendix B 'Phonetics' gives phone charts for those three only (e.g. Figure 3 Mur Pano phones, p. 39-40) with no prosody. Karnai [bbv] enters only (i) as one of ten previously elicited comparison wordlists in the WordSurv lexicostatistics (Mur Pano-Karnai 63%, Table p. 15-16; 170-item lists reproduced in A…
